name: Call of Fire

angles.text: As a shaman, you undertake a foundational trial in communion with fire. Sacred sapta lets you perceive and confront the spirits of flame.

faq.answer: Call of Fire is a sacred rite in which an initiate drinks prepared fire sapta, faces a spirit of flame, and offers its ember to a brazier to earn fire's favor.
faq.q: What is the Call of Fire?

faq.answer: Fire sapta is a prepared draught that opens an initiate's spiritual sight, revealing the elemental spirit waiting at the mountain peak.
faq.q: What is the purpose of the fire sapta?

faq.answer: A Minor Manifestation of Fire awaits the initiate atop the peak. It does not fight until struck.
faq.q: What spirit appears during the trial?

faq.answer: The elemental spirit grows fiercer and hotter as the battle wears on. A swift, decisive strike can subdue it before its flames overwhelm the initiate.
faq.q: Why must the fire spirit be defeated quickly?

faq.answer: After the Minor Manifestation of Fire is defeated, its glowing embers are carried to the brazier atop the Shrine of Eternal Flame to kindle the ritual torch.
faq.q: What is done with the glowing embers?

faq.answer: Kindling the torch earns the direct favor and communion of the fire elementals. The rite establishes a bond with the flames.
faq.q: What does earning the fire's favor mean?

sections.body: An initiate receives prepared fire sapta, guided by elemental lore. The draught awakens their senses to the unseen world. After drinking at the shrine, they climb toward the peak, where mortal sight gives way to primal forces. There, a dormant manifestation of fire awaits their challenge.
sections.title: The Rite of Flame

sections.body: The Minor Manifestation of Fire tests an initiate's resolve and endurance. It does not attack until challenged, then grows fiercer with each passing moment. When subdued, it yields glowing embers. Carry them to the brazier atop the Shrine of Eternal Flame to kindle the torch and win the spirit's lasting favor.
sections.title: Facing the Manifestation

summary: At the shrine, an initiate drinks fire sapta to face the trial called Call of Fire. The rite asks them to subdue a spirit and offer its embers to the sacred brazier.
